# PocketMATE

Read `AGENTS.md` in the repository root before suggesting changes. It is the
single source of truth for this project's architecture, conventions, and
constraints, and contains a task→document table pointing at `docs/`.

Also read the `AGENTS.md` in whichever directory you are editing — `src/app/`,
`src/app/api/`, `src/features/`, `src/lib/`, `src/components/`, or `tests/`.

Three rules that are violated most often:

- `src/app/(dashboard)/` and `src/app/(auth)/` are route groups. The parentheses
  are **never** part of a URL — it is `/bills`, not `/(dashboard)/bills`.
- Domain code goes in `src/features/<domain>/`, never in a route file. A
  `page.tsx` over ~120 lines means something belongs in a feature folder.
- Row types are snake_case, the API wire format is camelCase. Mutation bodies go
  through `toApiBody()` from `@/lib/case`, or columns get written NULL.

Do not edit this file. All content lives in `AGENTS.md`.
